    t0 = time.time()
    model = fasttext.train_supervised(
        input='/app/train.txt',

        epoch=epoch,
        lr=lr,
        wordNgrams=wordNgrams,
        minCount=minCount,
        bucket=bucket,
        minn=minn,
        maxn=maxn,
        loss=loss,
        thread=thread,
        verbose=verbose,
        seed=42,
